issues.description: Method name mismatch for the operation that clears the stock: the problem statement (UML and method list) declares a Stock method emptyStock(): void, and the reference solution implements emptyStock() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java. The template starter code, however, provides a method named clearInventory() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) for the same conceptual operation. This inconsistent identifier across problem statement, template, and solution can confuse students about which method to implement/call and may cause them to implement the wrong API or search for a missing method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API name consistent across all artifacts. Either rename the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock(), or add a new emptyStock() method in the template that delegates to clearInventory(). Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to use clearInventory(). Ensure tests and examples reference the same name so students can unambiguously implement and call the correct method.
